<h2>Run a Paired Spatial MEM Cross-Validation Fixture</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Runs exact and fast spatial MEM construction through identical fold
preparation, sjSDM fitting, and held-out prediction work.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_spatial_mev_paired_cv_fixture(
  data_community_matrix = NULL,
  data_abiotic_wide = NULL,
  data_coords_projected = NULL,
  data_sample_ids = NULL,
  data_assignments = NULL,
  candidate = NULL,
  sel_abiotic_formula = NULL,
  config_model_fitting = NULL,
  config_data_processing = NULL,
  device = "cpu",
  prepare_function = prepare_sjsdm_cross_validation_fold,
  fit_function = fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate,
  predict_function = predict_sjsdm_probability_matrix
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_community_matrix">data_community_matrix</code>, <code id="data_abiotic_wide">data_abiotic_wide</code>, <code id="data_coords_projected">data_coords_projected</code></td>
<td>
<p>Model inputs accepted by [prepare_sjsdm_cross_validation_fold()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_sample_ids">data_sample_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Sample metadata accepted by [prepare_sjsdm_cross_validation_fold()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Table containing 'repeat_id', 'fold_id', and 'row_index'. Each row index must
occur once in every repeat.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="candidate">candidate</code></td>
<td>
<p>One regularization candidate accepted by
[fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="sel_abiotic_formula">sel_abiotic_formula</code></td>
<td>
<p>Abiotic formula passed to [fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="config_model_fitting">config_model_fitting</code>, <code id="config_data_processing">config_data_processing</code></td>
<td>
<p>Shared model and data-processing configurations.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="device">device</code></td>
<td>
<p>Device passed to [fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prepare_function">prepare_function</code>, <code id="fit_function">fit_function</code>, <code id="predict_function">predict_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable production adapters used for focused orchestration tests.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing paired benchmark rows, predictions, and fold
diagnostics.
</p>
